note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (final year of the PRI presidency of Ernesto Zedillo), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: large business groups and the corporatist unions long tied to the PRI, a strong presidency-aligned bureaucracy, an influential broadcast media sector, and an army that stays out of politics.
